description: Standalone nutrition and food variety for Minecraft 1.20.1 Forge. Configurable stages, rewards and modpack integrations. Datapacks are maintained separately.

mods.name: L'DieDiet
mods.description:
Autonomous nutrition and food monotony system.
Tracks dietary variety, configurable nutrient scales and datapack-driven food rewards without requiring Diet.

releases.notes:
Minecraft Java **1.20.1** · **Forge 47.x** · **Java 17** · **MIT**

- Standalone food familiarity, nutrition scales, food groups and reward rules. Diet is optional.
- Four journal tabs, secret groups, threshold markers and effect sources.
- Configurable recovery, CCI, nutrition decay, death loss and modpack integrations.
- Installable food data is maintained separately: [datapack source](https://github.com/lbdumbra-jpg/l-diediet-datapacks) · [datapack downloads](https://github.com/lbdumbra-jpg/l-diediet-datapacks/releases/tag/v2.0.0).

Download the JAR and put it in `mods` on both client and server. The ZIP contains the original filename `l'diediet_2.0.0.jar` and MIT license. Choose one datapack for ready-made groups and nutrition. Open the journal with **N**.

Verified locally with **95 unit tests** and **126 Forge GameTests**. Datapacks were checked in vanilla and an isolated FreshCraft instance. Supported Diet version: **2.1.1+1.20.1**.

**RU:** Обновлённый мод; датапаки вынесены в отдельный репозиторий по ссылкам выше.
